The code is tested using the latest revision of the JDK for supported LTS releases: 8, 11, 17, 21 and 25 currently. See https://github.com/apache/commons-lang/blob/master/.github/workflows/maven.yml Please ensure your build environment is up-to-date and kindly report any build issues.
